agent_changes.description: Incendiary - Brim’s molotov audio has been updated to be easier to hear, especially when placed underneath smokes.

bug_fixes: Waylay
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where reactivating Refract immediately after casting Convergent Paths would prevent the reactivate from working.
Harbor
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Harbor’s water bracelet would sometimes bleed through thin walls like the doors on Ascent.
Deadlock
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Deadlock’s Barrier Mesh was not playing hit audio when shooting the center node.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where Deadlock’s Barrier Mesh could be used to boost players.
Vyse
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where the cooldown on Vyse’s Arc Rose was not properly set after it was destroyed.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Vyse’s activated Shear wall didn’t display the warning fade out visual cue.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where Vyse’s Shear wall blocked bullets after the visual wall despawned.
Thanks to SeismicChef on X for reporting the above issues!
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where Vyse’s Steel Garden warning indicator did not properly match the debuff area.
Yoru
Bugfix Reverted a bugfix that caused Yoru’s clone to slightly mismatch normal player movement when running into walls.
Skye
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where Skye’s Trailblazer leap did not get slowed by Waylay’s Saturate debuff.
Gekko
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where Gekko’s Thrash leap did not get slowed by Waylay’s Saturate debuff.
Tejo
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where players could boost on Tejo’s Stealth Drone.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where Stealth Drone could not be tagged by Cypher’s camera.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Armageddon VFX may remain after being used.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where there was no danger indicator for players running through Armeggadon from the back side.
Reyna
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where Reyna’s Devour Overheal would not be interrupted when taking damage that was less than her current Overheal amount.
Iso
Bugfix Updated Iso’s Double Tap tooltip to mention the reload speed buff. Thanks Reddit user /u/RemoteWhile5881!
Cosmetics
We’re currently aware of an issue within the Act III Battlepass where some Player Cards are currently displaying the incorrect item name.
We’ll be deploying a fix with the correct item names with Patch 10.09 in a couple of weeks.
Welcome to Stage V25A3! Matches start on May 7.

Adjustment We’ve updated our Premier Restrictions. Instead of a flat 30 day ineligibility, players who engage in disruptive behavior are now ineligible for Premier for a period of time based on the severity of the misconduct and the length of the active intervention.
Bugfix Lowered the size of the hover text for Rank Shields in the Summary screen.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where long player names would overlap certain elements in the Timeline screen.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where text explaining rank requirements for the current season was not shown on the Act Rank screen.
Bugfix Updated the Act Rank screen text to refer to Seasons.
